qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide pools, not purine ribonucleotide synthesis
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and breakdown
rationale: All members handle nucleotide/nucleoside pools (pyrimidine synthesis, salvage and catabolism, dNTP synthesis, NUDT sanitation, nucleoside-analog drug handling), distinguished from confusables by pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide content rather than purine ribonucleotide synthesis, purine salvage or abacavir handling.

qualifier: synthesis and homeostatic regulation
name: Sphingolipid synthesis and homeostatic regulation
rationale: Members cover sphingolipid/ceramide (amide membrane lipid) synthesis, catabolism and homeostasis, distinguished from confusables that add TNFR1-driven ceramide production, sphingomyelin breakdown or ER-Golgi lipid transfer.

qualifier: biogenesis and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride storage homeostasis
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization plus triglyceride/fatty acid storage homeostasis, distinguished from confusables focused on lipophagy, droplet disassembly, lipolysis or LXR-driven lipogenic transcription.

qualifier: chemokine-receptor binding, monocyte-centred
name: Chemokine receptor-driven monocyte and leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members share chemokine/chemokine-receptor-guided migration of monocytes, macrophages and NK cells, distinguished from confusables by chemokine-receptor binding clusters rather than monocyte activation, surface signatures or endothelial adhesion/extravasation.

qualifier: social, motor and reward-conditioned
name: Social, motor and reward-conditioned behaviour
rationale: Members are whole-animal behaviours (mating, parental, aggressive, grooming, locomotor, drinking, ethanol/nicotine response, conditioning), distinguished from confusables by reward conditioning, nicotine response and motor behaviours without stress-hormone, cocaine or neuropeptide/sleep signalling.

qualifier: receptor cleavage to intracellular-domain target transcription across paralogs
name: Notch receptor cleavage and intracellular-domain target gene transcription
rationale: All members concern canonical Notch activation and NICD-driven transcription (NOTCH1-4, Notch-HLH, developmental and Th2 targets), distinguished by NOTCH2/3/4 transcription and receptor processing rather than PEST/FBXW7 degradation or noncanonical NOTCH3/4 activation.

qualifier: innate receptor TAK1-IKK route incl. NOD1/2 and non-canonical NIK
name: Innate receptor TAK1-IKK activation of NF-kappaB and stress kinases
rationale: Members describe TLR/TRIF, NOD1/2 and TNFSF-driven TAK1/IKK/NIK activation of NF-kappaB, JNK and p38, distinguished from confusables by NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and non-canonical NIK signalling rather than TBK1-IRF3, TNFR1/linear ubiquitin or negative NF-kappaB control.

qualifier: nephron tubule patterning and differentiation
name: Kidney development with nephron tubule patterning and differentiation
rationale: Members cover metanephric/pronephric kidney and urinary duct development, distinguished from confusables (ureteric bud induction, kidney size) by nephron segment patterning and tubule differentiation (comma/S-shaped body, loop of Henle, distal tubule).

qualifier: fibroblast focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix
name: Fibroblast focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members concern integrin-fibronectin adhesion, focal adhesion assembly, SRF-linked cytoskeletal remodeling and fibroblast migration, distinguished from confusables by fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly rather than syndecan/stress-fibre, MET signalling or broad EMT/ECM signatures.

qualifier: endothelial fate specification and vascular smooth muscle, without BMP-driven cardiac remodeling
name: Endothelial fate specification and blood vessel morphogenesis with smooth muscle
rationale: Members concern endothelial fate commitment and arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation, vasculogenesis, artery/vein morphogenesis and vessel maturation with vascular smooth muscle, distinguished from confusables by endothelial specification and coronary/smooth-muscle content rather than BMP/SMAD signalling, valve/septum or pulmonary/outflow-tract development.

qualifier: heavy/transition metals with copper detoxification and redox control
name: Heavy metal ion response with copper detoxification and redox control
rationale: Members are cellular responses to copper, zinc, manganese, iron, cobalt, lead, mercury and selenium with metallothionein/MTF1 and redox/HMOX1 control, distinguished by copper detoxification and multi-metal scope rather than cadmium, ROS detoxification, AhR xenobiotics or ferroptosis.

qualifier: vesicle docking/priming and transmitter-specific release cycles
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle docking, SNARE assembly, priming and Ca2+-dependent exocytosis including glutamate, acetylcholine and monoamine release cycles, distinguished from confusables by these release cycles and positive exocytosis control rather than active zone maintenance, cholinergic NMJ or short-term plasticity.

qualifier: peroxide and nitrosative stress controlling intrinsic apoptosis
name: Peroxide and nitrosative stress responses and intrinsic apoptosis control
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to hydrogen peroxide, nitric oxide and reactive nitrogen species and their control of intrinsic apoptosis, distinguished by HMOX1 and NO/RNS responses rather than ferroptosis, mitochondrial respiration or ischemia.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water handling and epithelial salt transport
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water and epithelial salt transport homeostasis
rationale: Most members concern renal/epithelial water and Na/K/Cl transport, osmotic responses and blood pressure, distinguished from confusables by vasopressin-aquaporin water handling, chloride-transporter channelopathies (CFTR, SLC12/26) and osmosensing rather than aldosterone synthesis, P-type ATPases or NHEs.

qualifier: with vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactor metabolism and aldehyde detoxification
name: Glutathione, sulfur and cofactor metabolism with aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis/recycling, cysteine and sulfide metabolism, methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and cofactor (vitamin B6, molybdenum) metabolism, distinguished by vitamin B6 and aldehyde detoxification rather than selenium metabolism, transsulfuration or ROS/NADPH.

qualifier: pigmentation, melanin synthesis and light response
name: Melanocyte differentiation, melanin pigmentation and UV-light response
rationale: Members concern the MITF-M melanocyte programme, melanocyte differentiation and proliferation, melanin and pigment granule biology and UV/blue-light response, distinguished from confusables by pigmentation and light response rather than MITF-M cell-cycle/DNA-repair or melanosome assembly.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA control of glycogen and triglyceride
name: Glucagon-PKA control of glycogen and triglyceride mobilization
rationale: Members concern glucagon/PKA, AMPK and adiponectin control of glycogen turnover, glucokinase and triglyceride breakdown, distinguished from confusables by glycogen metabolism and glucokinase regulation rather than gluconeogenesis, insulin or glucose-sensing transcription.

qualifier: with sensorimotor function
name: MECP2-dependent neuronal gene regulation and sensorimotor function
rationale: Most members concern MECP2 function/dysfunction in neuronal transcription and chromatin, with related sensory and motor phenotypes, distinguished from confusables (broad neurobehaviour, glycinergic transmission) by the MECP2 transcriptional axis.

qualifier: Notch3/4 and p75NTR
name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of Notch and p75 neurotrophin receptors
rationale: Members describe cleavage-dependent nuclear signalling of membrane receptors, distinguished from confusables by p75NTR-NRIF death signalling and NOTCH3/4 rather than NOTCH1/2 or ERBB4.

qualifier: driving convergent extension
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern PCP establishment and the convergent extension it drives in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate, distinguished from confusables by convergent extension rather than WNT5A receptor internalization, axial/paraxial mesoderm or neural patterning.

qualifier: sleep-wake and stress hormone response
name: Neuropeptide GPCR control of sleep-wake, stress and social behaviour
rationale: Members link neuropeptide/GPCR signalling to sleep-wake states, stress and corticosteroid responses and social behaviours, distinguished by sleep-wake regulation and relaxin/orexin receptors rather than opioid or dense-core vesicle release.

qualifier: Th2 cytokines, mast cells and eosinophils
name: Th2-type allergic immunity of mast cells and eosinophils
rationale: Members concern Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signalling, FcepsilonRI mast-cell and eosinophil effector functions and IgE switching, distinguished from confusables (IL-2/7/15, IL-6, IL-10/12/23 families) by this type 2 axis.

qualifier: oocyte maturation and luteal phase
name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to ovulation and luteolysis
rationale: Members cover ovarian follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization/luteolysis and the estrous cycle, distinguished from confusables by oocyte maturation and luteal events rather than gonadotropin secretion/response or Sertoli cells.

qualifier: end protection and telomerase-independent replication
name: Telomere end protection, capping and telomerase-independent replication
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, protection from NHEJ/recombination, C-strand fill-in and recombination-based maintenance, distinguished from confusables by these telomerase-independent processes rather than telomerase recruitment, ATRX/DAXX defects or general fork processing.

qualifier: formyl-peptide and complement receptors
name: Neutrophil chemotaxis via formyl-peptide and complement chemoattractant receptors
rationale: Members concern GPCR-mediated neutrophil recruitment and responses, distinguished from confusables by complement receptor and formyl-peptide receptor signalling rather than chemokine production or extravasation.
